summary: Performs union, intersection, difference, and edge guide operations on two closed polygonal input sets.

key_params.name: booleanop
key_params.note: Boolean operation: union, intersect, A minus B, B minus A, or edge outputs

key_params.name: accattrib
key_params.note: Attempt to transfer point attributes to the boolean output

common_gotchas: Inputs must be completely closed polygonal sets; open tubes or unbacked extrusions are invalid.
Polygons must be convex and coplanar; use Extrude convex faces or Divide/Facet cleanup before Boolean.
Point colors and UVs are not interpolated correctly, and normals may need a follow-up Facet SOP.
Boolean may reverse polygons or produce twisted edge outputs; use Facet cleanup when closure or shading is wrong.
For NURBS or Bezier surface boolean-style work, use Surfsect SOP instead.
key_concepts: Boolean SOP performs union, intersection, subtraction, and edge-guide operations on two polygonal input sets.
Inputs must be closed polygonal geometry with convex, coplanar polygons for reliable results.
Guide geometry can be generated for A-edge and B-edge operations to inspect intersection boundaries.
NURBS or Bezier boolean-style workflows should use surface-intersection tools rather than Boolean SOP.
